title: Self-adjoint boundary conditions for the prolate spheroid differential operator
author: Victor Katsnelson

imported_content.maximal_domain: f in L2(-a,a), f_prime locally absolutely continuous, and the formal differential expression in L2
imported_content.canonical_boundary: limits at both endpoints of (1-x^2/a^2)f_prime(x) equal zero
imported_content.selfadjointness: the identity-matrix extension M_I is nonnegative selfadjoint
imported_content.prolate_extension: adding the bounded real multiplication potential x^2 preserves the domain and selfadjointness
imported_content.uniqueness: this boundary realization is the unique selfadjoint extension commuting with the matching truncated Fourier operator

project_scaling.project_boundary: limits at x->plus_or_minus_lambda of (lambda^2-x^2)f_prime(x) equal zero

wording_rule: Paraphrase theorem content; do not quote long source passages.
